title: clients: language option, locale/localizations fields, preferredLanguages, WS handshake Accept-Language
description:
jmap-base-client and family clients:
- Add urn:ietf:params:jmap:i18n to `using` when the caller asks for language.
- `language` option on the typed /get, /query and /queryChanges builders for localizable types.
- Typed `locale`/`localizations` fields on Mailbox, AddressBook, Principal, Calendar and Quota.
- Read I18nAccountCapability.preferredLanguages from the Session.
- A client-side helper that applies jmap_types::i18n::lookup to a full object, for offline language switching.
- An option to set Accept-Language on the WebSocket handshake. The draft says the server SHOULD use it for the whole connection.
- When the client caches by state, document that it must key the cache on `language` too.
notes:
Draft working copy (after 2b85363) adds: clients that know no base direction SHOULD use the first strong directional character, not the language tag (string-meta). Rustdoc only.
2026-11-15: preferredLanguages was DROPPED from draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 (working copy in jmap-chat-spec). The account value of urn:ietf:params:jmap:i18n is now {} like the Session value; the Account Language Preference section is gone (left to a future JMAP account-settings spec). Remove preferredLanguages from scope here.
preferredLanguages was dropped from the draft (2026-11-15): no Session::preferred_languages reader; the account capability is {}.
Done 2026-11-15. Decision 32 (Mark): client-wide with_i18n, not per-call variants. with_i18n returns Result: InvalidSession when the Session lacks the capability (an unadvertised URI in using fails the whole request). No preferredLanguages reader (dropped from the draft). The offline-view helper is jmap_types::i18n::localized_view (documented in base-client I18nSetting rustdoc, not re-exported: one public path). Typed locale/localizations come with the types (.7-.9). Calendars client: on .10.
close_reason: Clients: SessionClient::with_i18n (decision 32) in mail/contacts/sharing clients, base-client I18nSetting, WS handshake Accept-Language via connect_ws_with_options, cache/direction rustdoc; tests
